Pricey But Good
Jul 2020
This is seafood at its freshest. While there is a menu, you really end up relying on the wait staff to tell you what's fresh and in stock that day...and at what price per kilo! This is a seafood market in the front with two levels of dining beyond. There was a private room in the back that we didn't see. But, our dining area was spacious. I'd say that this was some of the best seafood I've ever had though it wasn't cheap. We paid the equivalent of USD 63 for three of us - which might be the most expensive meal we've had in Vietnam. But, the grilled oysters were the best I've EVER had. All of the food was absolutely delicious. 

The service was hurried but the place was packed - and packed with locals which is the way I prefer my restaurants. I loathe tourist traps and we found a good place here. So, if you have time in Ha Long, this is a great place to stop. We were actually in town to go to Sunworld Park but took a taxi to eat here instead of anywhere near the park.
